reference.title: Scenario 16 — Block Image Between Numbered List in a Procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider a numbered procedure in the document where the author has inserted a full-width screenshot

section.p: Consider a numbered procedure in the document where the author has inserted a full-width screenshot between two steps — for example, to illustrate what the screen looks like after completing step one.

table.title: Block image between steps in procedure

row.entry: [List Number]: 1. Open the application. [Block image: screenshot.png] [Caption]: The application main window [List Number]: 2. Click File > Open.

entry.codeblock: <task id="open_application"> <title>Open Application</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Open the application.</cmd> <info> <fig> <title>Application main window</title> <image href="media/screenshot.png"/> </fig> </info> </step> <step> <cmd> Click <menucascade> <uicontrol>File</uicontrol> <uicontrol>Open</uicontrol> </menucascade> </cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: The converter treats the inserted image as content outside the numbered list structure and moves the image into the preceding step's <info> element so that the task remains a single continuous <steps> structure.
